text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I feel lightheaded...
I don't think I
can train
like this...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I'll...
go over there and collect myself for
a
moment...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I'm back... Back here in my world...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It's so... relaxing here... Oh,
the sky... it's
a clock
today...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
The sun's the long hand and the moon's
the short hand... Hehe. A sun that
doesn't set... and a moon
that never
wanes.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Much like the cycle of reincarnation...
Time flows
in circles...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Time? I feel like something has slipped
my
mind...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Oh... The fish are...
flying? That's right,
the sea of
clouds is in high tide...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
If I try it now,
it should be safe to swim...
I think?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It looks fun,
but I shouldn't... If I do...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the tide will go back out if I don't
hurry...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Manhattan Cafe ends up
skipping
training...
